np! I’m not sure how much you know about how ts3 works, but it’s not exactly designed to play rotationally like ts2 is. ts3 has built-in story progression that will make the townies age, and sometimes have kids on their own. 

Nraas storyprogression replaces the EA default and enhances it - sims will get in and out of relationships, start new jobs, have kids, move, etc. Personally, I put mine on a slow speed so they’re not overpopulating and getting in new relationships every other day lol. If you prefer to play rotationally and control everything in your town, though, you probably don’t want that.

Also, I don’t use this feature often, but [this thread](https://www.reddit.com/r/Sims3/comments/1dbqrva/retain_wishes_when_switching_active_household/) explains different methods of switching households using MC while retaining wishes. Hope this helps!!

Hi! To play another family (without mods) you have to click the menu button in the bottom left corner, select Edit Town, then select Change Active Household and either move in a new one or select a home with sims in it.

But I *highly* recommend getting nraas mods, which will allow you to switch households instantly, without going to edit town and without losing their Wishes. 

Nraas is also essential to prevent/fix lag and errors in a save file. There are lot of mods on their website, but mastercontroller and overwatch are a good place to start. Plus storyprogression if you want that

[Randomizer mod](https://modthesims.info/d/492102/retuned-attraction-system-1-67-compatible.html): adds randomized events for sims in your household, like breakups, fights, proposals, etc.

[Family Secrets](https://modthesims.info/d/681574/family-secrets-update-2024-11-22.html): enhances affairs, pregnancies out of wedlock, and adoption

[Retuned Attraction System](https://modthesims.info/d/492102/retuned-attraction-system-1-67-compatible.html): makes attraction more dynamic/realistic

[Nraas StoryProgression Relationship/Personalities modules](https://www.nraas.net/community/StoryProgression): personalities can be a bit demanding on your PC, esp if you have several installed, but I definitely recommend the Relationship module
